list: the official 55 trophies, live on PlayStation since 2026-11-18
note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide is written in our own words for this entry and names its source. The game launched on 2026-11-19.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete Trophy List + 100% Guide
Radio Times — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (full list)
Official PS5 list — Exophase / PSNProfiles (as shipped in the kit)

disputes.title: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation required?
disputes.a: PowerPyx earned the trophy having done the Chapter 1 meditation, and warns it vanishes after Chapter 1.
disputes.b: The same guide notes the balcony meditation raises the progress counter but is not marked as a meditation spot like the other 18, so whether it counts is unclear.
disputes.call: Do it in Chapter 1. It costs nothing and covers every reading.

disputes.title: Meditations: 15 or 18?
disputes.a: The trophy needs all 18 meditation spots.
disputes.call: Both are true — different targets. Do all 18 and both are covered.

disputes.title: What is the final mission called?
disputes.a: PowerPyx trophy page links the final-mission gold to Starting From Zero.
disputes.b: PowerPyx walkthrough lists the final mission of Chapter 5 as The End of the Road.
disputes.call: We say only the final story mission, and show both names here.

disputes.title: How long does the platinum take?
disputes.b: Over 300 hours (Push Square, work in progress).
disputes.call: Plan on 200 hours; slower players should expect more.

disputes.title: How many areas is Leonida?
disputes.b: No external source states a count; PowerPyx says only to fully unfog the whole map.
disputes.call: 52 is unverified. We do not state it as fact.

disputes.title: How many missions are in Chapter 5?
disputes.call: Totals of 91 to 93 main missions are quoted depending on what is counted.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. Everything is single-player, one playthrough is enough, no online trophy exists, and the run takes roughly 200 hours.

steps.t: Play the story and collect the 12 story trophies as they come.
After the credits, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and work the 35-line checklist.
Sweep the stranger strands and the last miscellaneous trophies in free roam.
Keep a manual save at every chapter boundary. There is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete Gone Fishing, the second mission of Chapter 1. It pops on its own as the story moves forward, with nothing special to do.

steps.t: Play through the Chapter 1 opening until Gone Fishing starts.
Finish the mission. The trophy is automatic and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy pops just after the chapter ends, once the first mission of Chapter 2 is done.

steps.t: Complete every Chapter 1 mission in story order.
Start Chapter 2 and finish its opening mission to trigger the pop.
Note the naming quirk: each chapter trophy carries the NEXT chapter's name.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. The trophy pops after the first mission of Chapter 3, as with the earlier chapter trophies.

steps.t: Complete every Chapter 2 mission, including the Coffee Break unlock.
Start Chapter 3 and finish its opening mission to trigger the pop.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3, the longest chapter. The trophy pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4.

steps.t: Complete all 26 Chapter 3 missions, ending with the Cartel Heist.
Play the first two Chapter 4 missions to trigger the pop.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The trophy pops after the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero.

steps.t: Complete all 25 Chapter 4 missions.
Finish Starting From Zero, the chapter finale, to trigger the pop.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission in Chapter 5. The gold pops with the end of the story. Sources disagree on the final mission's name, so this guide names only the final story mission.

steps.t: Play through Chapter 5 to the finale.
Finish the final story mission. The gold is automatic.
Name dispute: one PowerPyx page says Starting From Zero, its walkthrough says The End of the Road. See the dispute box.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission, so the trophy is automatic and cannot be missed.

steps.t: Reach Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 by following the story.
Finish the mission. No extra objective is needed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, the heist finale of Chapter 3. A story trophy: automatic, unmissable.

steps.t: Play through Chapter 3 until the heist finale unlocks.
Finish The Cartel Heist. The trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. Story trophy: automatic and unmissable.

steps.t: Reach Child's Play in Chapter 4 by following the story.
Finish the mission. No extra objective is needed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. Story trophy: automatic and unmissable.

steps.t: Reach Headliners in Chapter 4 by following the story.
Finish the mission. No extra objective is needed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, the Chapter 4 airport heist. Story trophy: automatic and unmissable.

steps.t: Play through Chapter 4 until the airport heist unlocks.
Finish VCIA Takedown. The trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. Story trophy: automatic and unmissable.

steps.t: Reach Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5 by following the story.
Finish the mission. No extra objective is needed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist has 35 lines and only appears after the story, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. Progress made during the story counts, and nothing on it is missable.

steps.t: Finish the story first. Everything you did along the way already counts.
Open the 35-line checklist and work it in order: story tasks, exploration, discovery.
Mind the no-slack lines: gang operations, bank jobs, vaults, drone trials, target decks.
Use the 100% Ledger tab in this guide to track every line.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game: jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past this trophy.

steps.t: Open the map, Exploration, Stunt Spots to see every stunt location.
Under the Bridges are the quickest: 202 exist, and each counts.
Track progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts.
Push on to 300 stunts for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. It comes naturally during the story.

steps.t: Check what you have tried under Touchpad, Progress, Activities.
Pick off the missing types one by one. Each needs a single try, not a win.
A race win and a stunt also count toward their own trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 range locations. All 42 golds are also required for 100% completion.

steps.t: Visit all 12 Shooting Range locations.
Replay each challenge until it clears at gold.
Ranges also raise Focus level, which helps Gunslinger later.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total, and the 100% checklist needs all 42 time trials.

steps.t: Find the 14 Top Fun locations across Leonida.
Win one race at each location.
For 100%, return and clear all 42 time trials.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Forty unique race locations exist, and the 100% checklist needs 30 wins, so this pops on the way.

steps.t: Race at new locations rather than repeating one.
Twenty different wins trigger the trophy.
Push on to 30 wins for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento.

steps.t: Finish Feng Shui in Chapter 1 to meet Cal.
Follow his text to the fishing spot, marked purple, west of Key Lento.
Win the fishing challenge against him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade video game by finishing all of its levels once. Four games exist; three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1.

steps.t: Play a video game on the home TV or at an arcade machine.
Finish every level of that one game.
The 100% checklist needs all 4 games played, so try the rest too.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's questline, which is Lucia-only. It is marked in Chapter 3 with a call and a text giving an address in Belville, and it stays available after the story.

steps.t: As Lucia, answer Andy's call and text in Chapter 3.
Work through the five quests, ending with Puff Puff Pass.
It stays open after the story, so there is no rush.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's questline: clear 7 shipwrecks by treasure diving. It is marked in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams, at Key Lento. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2 to 3.

steps.t: Find the green KR icon at Key Lento after Island Dreams.
Dive the 7 shipwrecks, using the metal detector on the ocean floor.
Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.
If he is unavailable, keep playing: he returns in Chapter 2 to 3.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's questline at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. It is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and stays available after the story.

steps.t: Finish Coffee Break in Chapter 2, then head to the Mud Club.
Work through the five quests, ending with Hometown Heroes.
It stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying stranger strands. Warning: not every side quest counts. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count. Confirmed counting strands are Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, and more strangers are still being discovered.

steps.t: Do the confirmed counting strands: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Do not count Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy or Eddie toward the 8.
Watch the trophy tracker as you finish strands; more are still being found.
All strands stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's Wish List: deliver 16 sports cars he wants. It unlocks after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which gives you the Key Cloner.

steps.t: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 to unlock the Key Cloner.
Find Randy at the green RK icon in west Vice City.
Deliver the 16 cars on his list, starting with the Zorrusso from the mission.
Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's questline, which is Jason-only. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and stays available after the story.

steps.t: As Jason, finish Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3.
Destroy the Synthetic Labs at the purple markers in Vice City.
Finish the final quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Each spot counts once per character, so meditating with both Jason and Lucia doubles progress. This is the only trophy that may be missable: one meditation happens on a balcony in Chapter 1 and never returns, so do it while Chapter 1 lasts.

steps.t: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning.
When she says she is going to meditate, follow her to the balcony and accept.
Meditate at the other spots with both characters: each counts once per character.
Track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.
The 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18. The trophy needs all 18.
Whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is actually required is still unconfirmed. Do it anyway: it costs nothing.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His questline is Jason-only and opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when Bret texts you. Which exact animal unlocks the trophy is still unconfirmed, so hunt every animal he requests.

steps.t: As Jason, finish Coffee Break in Chapter 2 and wait for Bret's text.
Meet him in Lummox County and take his hunting requests.
Hunt each requested animal and bring it back to Bret.
All 15 Target Decks are needed for 100% completion.
The exact unlocking animal is still unconfirmed. Do the whole line.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Eighteen sets exist with 480 cards in total, and the 100% checklist needs 15 sets, so keep collecting past this trophy.

steps.t: Pick up cards as you explore; they sit in shops, homes and landmarks.
Finish any 3 full sets to trigger the trophy.
Push on to 15 sets for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK-scan 100 locations by holding Up and pressing R1. Landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags all count, and more than 100 exist.

steps.t: Scan as you travel: hold Up, then R1, at anything scannable.
Landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count toward the 100.
WAiNK also scans vehicles, which feeds Whip It Good.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges, in 8 groups of 10. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way there.

steps.t: Open Progress, Challenges to see all 8 groups.
Clear any 50 challenges across the groups.
Push on to 70 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. It pops on its own during the Chapter 4 bank vault robberies, which always draw 4 stars, so most players get it for free.

steps.t: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, you can free-roam with your partner.
Call your partner with hold Right plus Triangle.
At 4 stars, leave the red heat zone entirely, not just the search area.
Easiest escape: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County.
Or just play on: the Chapter 4 vault robberies pop it automatically.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Keep the flashing wanted level alive between shops; the pop is delayed about 30 seconds after the third shop.

steps.t: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, bring your partner along.
Rob three shops in a row, keeping the wanted level flashing.
Wait about 30 seconds after the third shop. If nothing pops, hit a fourth.
Good spot: three jewelry stores in north Vice City, after Yasmani's jobs.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK. You do not need to drive them. With 557 vehicles in the game, this pops naturally if you scan as you travel.

steps.t: Scan vehicles with WAiNK: hold Up, then R1.
You do not need to drive a vehicle to discover it.
Track it under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models scanned.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Focus slows time and highlights weak spots; it does not work on soldiers, police or civilians, so use it on criminals at gang operations.

steps.t: Trigger Combat Focus with L3 plus R3 while aiming.
Buff your focus first with food, drink or a shower, and use Adrenaline to extend it.
Fight criminals at a gang operation with an assault rifle and body armor.
It is easier at Focus Level 4, raised through ranges, golf, pool and headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA, take off, and fly one kilometre away from the airport. Planes sitting on the open airfield do not count.

steps.t: Enter VCIA and find a large plane docked at a bridge. Terminals E3 and E4 are easiest.
Use the stairs by the bridge to get inside, then go upstairs to the cockpit.
Reverse to the airstrip, take off, and fly 1 km from the airport.
The pop is delayed. Keep flying until it lands.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge in Mariana County. The tanks sit in the south of the base.

steps.t: Reach Mile Zero Air Station on the island in the south-west.
Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Enter a tank in the south of the base and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks silent lockpicking and jewelry store robberies.

steps.t: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun. Do not kick the door: it triggers the alarm.
Find the safe-code note, loot the safe, then destroy the security footage and disable the alarm in the backroom.
The trophy pops shortly after you leave.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Eight exist and all 8 are needed for 100%. The intro vault robbery is the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is.

steps.t: Do the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is first.
After that, pay Yasmani 10,000 dollars a tip for security-van locations.
Tail a van to a bank, enter while the vault is open, and bring your partner to hand off a bag.
Expect an instant 4-star wanted level. Escape by fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles.
Rob all 8 vaults for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since robbing a bank vault counts for it.

steps.t: Do the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is. It pops by itself.
Early method: block an armored truck near a bank and sticky-bomb its back door.
Escape the red heat radius to finish it.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully explore Leonida by unfogging the whole map. The fastest way is by plane. Note: the kit starter claims 52 areas, but no external source states that number, so this guide does not present it as fact.

steps.t: Fly across the whole map to unfog it. A plane is fastest.
Check the map for fogged patches and sweep them last.
The 52-area figure is unverified. See the dispute box.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Thirty-nine operations exist in total, and all 39 are needed for 100% completion.

steps.t: Illegal Operations show as yellow map icons when you are near.
Many are marked automatically as the story progresses.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Track it under Progress, Gangs, and clear all 39 for 100%.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it standing next to the bar.

steps.t: Head to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini.
Drink it standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, and only this specific car counts.

steps.t: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 to get the Key Cloner.
Go to the showroom in south Vice City and take the blue Banshee.
Drive it straight through the showroom window. The pop is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: CORRECTED: this trophy is not about bowling. Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police.

steps.t: Do not bowl. This is a robbery at Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn.
Take the luxury watch in the south-east office.
Take the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 from the north-east table.
Open the safe in the north-east hallway with sticky bombs.
Escape the police. The trophy pops once you are clear.
Not missable: the robbery icon respawns, and valuables can be collected across visits.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. It only works after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when character switching unlocks. Train together at fitness clubs: while one trains, the other completes training automatically.

steps.t: Finish Coffee Break in Chapter 2 to unlock switching.
Call your partner and work out together at a fitness club.
While one trains, the other auto-completes training, so both gain at once.
Check Strength for both under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. The count is visible by opening the trophy in the trophy list. It pops passively during 100% work; turn on criminal-profile notifications to watch it grow.

steps.t: Turn on notifications: Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile.
Play normally. Robberies, chases and takedowns all feed the count.
Avoid the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent, and police shoot on sight.
If you are short at the end, farm actions in free roam.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNKNOWN: as of 20 Nov 2026, no guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. The best current belief is that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific way. This guide will not present a guess as a method.

steps.t: Status: method not yet confirmed by any guide site.
Current best belief: the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, in Little Cuba, Vice City.
Test protocol: revisit the store after the story and try robbing it again.
Do not trust one-liner guesses. Check back once a guide confirms it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness the UFO easter egg. On the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM and alone, a blinking car sometimes waits at the roadside. Follow the path into the woods to the bright blue light.

steps.t: Go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel, Kelly County, after 2 AM.
Look for a blinking car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random: drive away and return if it is absent.
Follow the path into the woods toward the bright blue light.
Watch the UFO drop the abducted woman, talk to her, offer help, and walk back to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: On any bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded streets in Vice City or Ocean Beach make it easy.

steps.t: Get any bike and ride to a crowded area: Vice City or Ocean Beach.
Kick pedestrians with Square as you ride past.
Land 10 kicks inside 60 seconds.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder 250,000 dollars in Marked Bills through your contacts. You need the Dye Pack Jammer from the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which introduces Raul's crew. Bills come from banks and Payday Loans, and the total is cumulative.

steps.t: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Collect Marked Bills from banks and Payday Loans.
Launder them through a fence. Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
Bank vaults pay up to 205,000 dollars each, so this comes naturally with 100% robberies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend 100,000 dollars across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn money.

steps.t: Spend across any shops: guns, mods, tattoos, clothing, food.
Car mods and weapons move the total fastest.
The total is cumulative across the whole playthrough.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garage properties, 160,000 dollars in total, through the Vice City Real Estate phone app. Four more garages come from the story and do not count.

steps.t: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2, stealing the Crawler for Moses.
Open the Vice City Real Estate app on the phone.
Buy all 8 garages. Total cost is 160,000 dollars.
Story garages do not count toward the 8.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then respray and register them.

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to install the Scooter Bros app.
Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn.
Choose Respray, then Register, for each vehicle.
Use cheap cars and bikes to keep the cost down. Each garage adds parking spots.
From Chapter 3, Standard Tracker cars can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray.
